steps.objective: Walk up the street toward the Guildhall.
steps.tip: Tap the ground to walk there. On a keyboard, A/D or the arrow keys work too.

steps.objective: Read the notice on the board.
steps.tip: Glowing markers show things you can use. Tap one and you'll walk over to it. Objects that hold a memory of the past are called Echoes.
What you learn from Echoes is kept in your Chronicle (top right). The letter that brought you here is already in it.

steps.objective: Work out who sent you the letter.
steps.tip: In the Chronicle, choose Who and Where for the event, using what your Echoes say. It's only accepted when every part is right, so compare them carefully.

steps.objective: Knock at the night door and go inside.
steps.tip: Doors and passages lead to new places. Now that you know who's waiting, the night door will open.
Tap people to talk to them. If you're ever unsure what to do next, ask. They often know where to look.

steps.objective: Search the Guildhall for Echoes of the night the lamps went out.
Set down in your Chronicle what happened that night.
The lamps are lit. Explore, or see what Pell and Wren have to say.
